about.title: Symy AI
about.p1: Symy AI is a green-consumption AI companion built by the Symy team — at the moment of decision, Symy the little elephant holds the green gate for you and the planet.
about.p2: In 2026, big tech AI has become a tool for exploiting consumers — TikTok Shop predicts what you want to buy, TEMU dynamically prices to extract every cent, Instagram uses AI to keep you scrolling endlessly.
about.p3: Symy AI is the opposite: AI that holds the green gate for you at the moment of purchase — fewer things bought, fewer lives taken.
about.mission: Buy less, live more — less bought, less made. Symy holds the gate.
about.why1: See the real cost — every purchase in hours of your life, not just dollars.
about.why2: See the real cost — TikTok, Instagram, Amazon spending traps named and defused.
about.why3: A companion that grows with you — not another app that judges you.
about.why4: Win back what you didn't spend — turn "I didn't buy" into real progress toward your dreams.

story1.body: Late at night I found the outfit again, thumb hovering over checkout. A few extra minutes with my little elephant let the urge settle. That piece stayed unbought, so it stayed unmade — and a few hours of freedom genuinely stayed in my life.

story2.name: MoonGazer
story2.title: “Only 3 left” stopped chasing me
story2.body: The livestream kept insisting only three were left, and I almost bought with the urgency. A challenge paused me at the guardrail, so I closed the page. A week later I thanked that version of me: one fewer impulse parcel, one more quiet breath.

story3.name: WaveRider
story3.title: My first dream fund was money I guarded
story3.body: Each time an impulse arrived, I moved that money into my dream fund instead. It slowly grew into my first small dream — a quiet night in the mountains. Guarding my choice wasn’t just buying less; it was growing my way back to where I wanted to be.
